summary: The limited Charizard and Fire Friends pack drove a wave of Solflare Packs posts. Most came from Solflare ambassadors and Guardians, plus a few organic collector reactions. Rivals were busy too: Moonshot shared a PSA 10 pull from a $50 pack, Disney Pinnacle teased a limited set, and a new digital-pack app (Packly) got promoted. On the collector side, people talked about Target drops, grading delays, and buying Pokémon packs with Apple Pay instead of crypto.

top_posts.text: @Collect Grading psa through fanatics has been an absolute nightmare. 90 buiness day turnaround on 40 day estimate. Communication couldn't be worse. Lies and gasliting. I asked for a refund on my $600 fees and was offered $5 credit as a one black member. Insane
top_posts.why_it_matters: PSA via Fanatics: 90 business days vs a 40-day estimate, and a $5 credit on $600 fees. Grading pain we already skip with pre-graded cards.
